note: Controlled vocabulary for the index. Each feature's category maps to exactly one theme. New annotations use these theme names as the category directly. A theme may also draw on claims through claim_topics; a theme with no categories is made of what people said, and a feature shows under it when a claim with that topic is about it.

themes.name: Structure
themes.blurb: Frames, walls, roofs, foundations and how the buildings stand up.

themes.name: Materials
themes.blurb: What things are made of, where it came from, and how it was worked.

themes.name: Water
themes.blurb: Wells, springs, rain, tanks, filters, pools and where it all goes.

themes.name: Energy and heating
themes.blurb: Stoves, solar, batteries, wiring and keeping warm.

themes.name: Climate and light
themes.blurb: Sun, shade, mass, ventilation and daylight.

themes.name: Food and land
themes.blurb: Gardens, orchards, animals, hay, woodland, water on the land.

themes.name: Living
themes.blurb: Rooms, furnishings, daily life, temporary homes.

themes.name: Community and shared life
themes.blurb: Shared houses and meals, paths and parking, decisions, neighbours.

themes.name: Money, plans and process
themes.blurb: What it cost, sequence of work, and what is still planned.

themes.name: Permits and the law
themes.blurb: What owners say they had to get approved, what they kept small to avoid it, and what got shut down. Their law, not yours.
